Scene:
古代时候，人不知道他们能吃什么植物，常常一吃就死。但是不知道为什么，没有办法。所以有一天，神农出去试一试很多种植物，告诉人什么植物是安全什么是危险。

The teacher's corrections on this scene:
- 古代时候，人不知道他们能吃什么植物：古代的时候，人们
- 所以有一天，神农出去试一试很多种植物：better to briefly introduce “神农” when this character first appears
- 告诉人什么植物是安全什么是危险：是安全的，是危险的
- 发现有的植物对身体非常好，特别是茶，让肚子感觉又暖和又清楚：add他in the beginning; delete 感觉，又暖和又舒服

The system's item in each run:
Run 1: Coherence (Reference): 神农：一个叫神农的人，this is the character’s first mention, so introduce him with a full noun phrase rather than assuming the reader already knows who he is. [rule: character_introduction_first_mention]
Run 2: Coherence (Reference): 神农：一个叫神农的老人，This is the character’s first mention, so introduce him with a name and a brief noun phrase rather than using only the name. [rule: character_introduction_first_mention]
Run 3: (nothing flagged here)

output.reason: Runs 1 and 2 address the same first-mention introduction issue, but Run 3 flags nothing.
